[ASSISTANT_CREATED] **Classic Buttermilk Scones Recipe**  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Ingredients:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2 1/4 cups (285g) all-purpose flour  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1/4 cup (50g) granulated sugar  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1/2 teaspoon baking powder  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1/2 teaspoon salt  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1/2 cup (115g) cold unsalted butter, cut into small pieces  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3/4 cup (180ml) buttermilk  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1 large egg, beaten  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Optional: 1 teaspoon vanilla extract

[USER] The user asked if they can substitute all-purpose flour with bread flour.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Bread flour can be used in scones but will affect the final texture and character.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Bread flour has a higher protein content (12-14%) compared to all-purpose flour (10-12%).  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Scones made with bread flour might be slightly more dense and heavier.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Tips for using bread flour in scones, including reducing the buttermilk and being gentle when mixing the dough.
